app_header.title: ST SlackBot Application Header
app_header.description: Displays the active bot version, authenticated user session, and the current operational mode (PD vs LC).
app_header.tip: Use the Guide button here anytime to toggle interactive help overlays across the entire app.

guide_toggle.title: Guide & Help Overlay
guide_toggle.description: Toggles interactive help mode on and off. When enabled, interactive badges and hover tooltips appear across the app explaining what each section does and how to use it.
guide_toggle.tip: Toggle this off when you are ready to work without visual help markers.

mode_badge.title: Active Bot Mode
mode_badge.description: Indicates whether the dispatcher is operating in PD Mode (Performance Director: songs & individual feedback) or LC Mode (Leadership Committee: individual columns).
mode_badge.tip: ST-SlackBot automatically detects the mode when you load a spreadsheet in Step 1, but you can override it if necessary.

roster_directory.title: Member Roster & Slack IDs
roster_directory.description: Maintains the directory connecting spreadsheet names (e.g. 'audrey', 'brian') to their unique Slack User IDs (e.g. 'U0123456789'). Feedback cannot be dispatched without a valid Slack ID.
roster_directory.tip: All names are stored in lowercase for reliable case-insensitive matching.

roster_fetch.title: Fetch Members from Slack (users:read)
roster_fetch.description: Connects to the Slack API (users.list) using your bot token to automatically fetch all active, human workspace members and their Slack IDs.
roster_fetch.tip: Requires the 'users:read' OAuth scope on your bot token. After fetching, you only need to adjust the spreadsheet name column to match your form.

roster_import.title: Import Roster JSON
roster_import.description: Upload an existing 'name_list.json' file from your computer. Supports flexible JSON structures (flat dictionary, arrays of objects, or Slack user exports).
roster_import.tip: Importing automatically merges with existing entries and validates Slack IDs.

roster_export.title: Export Roster JSON
roster_export.description: Downloads the current in-memory roster as a clean 'name_list.json' file so you can back it up or use it in CLI mode.
roster_export.tip: Always download a backup after making significant name adjustments or fetching a new cohort.

roster_editor.title: Interactive Member Directory Table
roster_editor.description: An editable grid allowing you to rename spreadsheet aliases, add new members, paste Slack IDs, or delete members.
roster_editor.tip: Double-click any cell in the 'Spreadsheet Name' column to edit. Click 'Save Directory Changes' below the table to persist your edits.

spreadsheet_selection.title: Spreadsheet Selection & Upload
spreadsheet_selection.description: Select an existing Excel file (.xlsx) from the 'spreadsheets/' folder or drag-and-drop a new form export.
spreadsheet_selection.tip: Export your Google Form responses as an Excel file (.xlsx) and drop it here.

mode_detection.title: Automatic Format Detection
mode_detection.description: Analyzes sheet column headers against known member names and search keywords to automatically determine if the file is in PD Mode or LC Mode.
mode_detection.tip: If the sheet contains columns matching keywords like 'Group' and 'Individual', PD mode is chosen. If columns match member names directly, LC mode is chosen.

mode_override.title: Manual Mode Override
mode_override.description: Allows you to manually switch between PD and LC modes if the spreadsheet header format is unconventional or detected incorrectly.
mode_override.tip: Switching modes resets group column assignments to ensure clean state.

message_header.title: Message Header Banner
message_header.description: Customizable banner text placed at the very top of each Slack DM, identifying which practice performance, event, or review cycle the feedback belongs to.
message_header.tip: Defaults to 'Feedback: <Spreadsheet_Name>'. Formats automatically with a Slack emoji and divider bar.

sheet_preview.title: Spreadsheet Header & Row Inspector
sheet_preview.description: An expander showing the column headers and first few response rows of the loaded workbook for quick verification.
sheet_preview.tip: Useful to confirm that the spreadsheet columns correspond to the expected questions and songs.

optional_settings.title: Optional & Advanced Settings
optional_settings.description: Collapsible settings panel containing your Slack bot token, keyword categories for group detection, and 'config.json' file import/export.
optional_settings.tip: Tucked away by default to keep the main workflow clean and uncluttered.

slack_token.title: Slack Bot Token (SLACK_BOT_TOKEN)
slack_token.description: Your workspace's Slack Bot OAuth token (starting with 'xoxb-'). Used for testing auth, fetching users, and delivering direct messages.
slack_token.tip: Click 'Test Slack Connection' to verify connectivity. On Streamlit Cloud, store this in App Settings → Secrets.

group_keywords.title: Group Column Keywords
group_keywords.description: Comma-separated terms used to identify Group/Song feedback columns (e.g. 'Group', 'Ensemble', 'Feedback', 'Arashi', '3 Sizzlin').
group_keywords.tip: Add song names or ensemble keywords here if your form questions do not explicitly use the word 'Group'.

indiv_keywords.title: Individual Column Keywords
indiv_keywords.description: Comma-separated terms used to identify Individual feedback columns (e.g. 'Individual', 'Indiv', 'Solo').
indiv_keywords.tip: Kept separate from group keywords so individual feedback columns are never mistakenly classified as group songs.

exclude_keywords.title: Excluded Header Keywords
exclude_keywords.description: Comma-separated terms used to ignore columns from group detection (e.g. 'PDs', 'ADs', 'Directors', 'Leadership', 'Timestamp', 'Your name').
exclude_keywords.tip: Prevents organizer feedback or administrative questions from being mistakenly detected as performance groups.

config_io.title: Configuration File I/O
config_io.description: Import or backup the active 'config.json' file containing API URLs, folder paths, mode settings, and keyword lists.
config_io.tip: Importing a config file updates all settings across the session immediately.

parse_proceed_button.title: Parse Spreadsheet & Proceed
parse_proceed_button.description: Scans the spreadsheet columns, detects groups/columns according to your keywords, and parses comments into memory.
parse_proceed_button.tip: Click this button once your spreadsheet is loaded to move forward to Step 2 (Review Groups).

groups_overview.title: Performance Groups & Member Assignment
groups_overview.description: Review every detected performance piece or committee question, verify column pairings, and assign members who performed in each piece.
groups_overview.tip: Member assignment determines who receives the feedback for that specific group or song.

auto_detect_all.title: Auto-Detect All from Comments
auto_detect_all.description: Scans all comment cells and group headers for mentions of known member names and automatically populates their group assignments.
auto_detect_all.tip: One click populates most group rosters if reviewers typed member names in individual comments!

add_group.title: Add New Group
add_group.description: Manually add a new group card if the spreadsheet has additional songs or questions not caught by initial detection.
add_group.tip: You can customize the group name and select any column from the dropdowns.

clear_group_names.title: Clear All Group Names
clear_group_names.description: Empties member assignments across all groups without deleting the group configurations.
clear_group_names.tip: Useful if you want to start fresh or re-run auto-detection with updated roster names.

reset_groups.title: Reset Groups from Spreadsheet
reset_groups.description: Re-runs column detection on the spreadsheet headers, restoring the initial detected groups and clearing overrides.
reset_groups.tip: Use this if you accidentally deleted a group or modified column dropdowns incorrectly.

group_card.title: Group Card Configuration
group_card.description: Configures an individual performance piece: its display name, its Group feedback column, its paired Individual feedback column, and its assigned members.
group_card.tip: If a song only has group feedback (like Arashi), set the Individual Feedback Column to '(None)'.

group_col_select.title: Group Feedback Column
group_col_select.description: The spreadsheet column containing general feedback for the whole group or ensemble. All assigned members will receive all comments from this column.
group_col_select.tip: Dropdown shows column numbers and header titles for easy identification.

indiv_col_select.title: Individual Feedback Column
indiv_col_select.description: The spreadsheet column containing individual member notes. Comments in this column are filtered so each member only receives lines mentioning their name.
indiv_col_select.tip: If a piece has no individual feedback column, select '(None)'.

member_multiselect.title: Member Assignment Multi-Select
member_multiselect.description: Select members who performed in this group. You can search known names or type a custom name and press Enter to add a new member.
member_multiselect.tip: Typing a new name automatically creates an entry for them in the directory.

detect_single_group.title: Detect Members for Group
detect_single_group.description: Scans this specific group's individual column and header to find and add mentioned members.
detect_single_group.tip: Useful when fine-tuning a single group without touching other groups.

unassigned_warnings.title: Unassigned Member Warnings
unassigned_warnings.description: Alerts you if members in your roster are not assigned to any group, or if names mentioned in the comments were not assigned to that group.
unassigned_warnings.tip: Click 'Add Missing' on any group card to instantly assign mentioned names.

membership_summary.title: Membership Summary Table
membership_summary.description: An overview table showing each assigned member, their Slack ID status, and the list of groups they belong to.
membership_summary.tip: Expand this table to verify that everyone is in the expected number of songs.

generate_comments_btn.title: Generate & Update Comments for Preview
generate_comments_btn.description: Compiles all group notes, filters individual comments per member, formats Slack markdown messages, and prepares them for preview.
generate_comments_btn.tip: Click this button whenever you change group member assignments to refresh the preview in Step 3.

lc_overview.title: Leadership Committee (LC) Column Mapping
lc_overview.description: In LC mode, columns in the spreadsheet correspond directly to member names. Each member receives all feedback rows under their column.
lc_overview.tip: Verify that all columns matched the expected members.

comments_overview.title: Step 3: Sample & Comment Preview
comments_overview.description: Inspect the exact formatted Slack direct message that each member will receive before dispatching anything.
comments_overview.tip: Use the sample selector or Random button to inspect multiple recipients.

recipient_metrics.title: Recipient & Delivery Metrics
recipient_metrics.description: Shows the total count of recipients, how many have valid Slack IDs, missing IDs count, and average message character length.
recipient_metrics.tip: If 'Missing Slack IDs' is greater than 0, add their IDs in Step 1 to ensure delivery.

recipient_selector.title: Recipient Selector & Random Sample
recipient_selector.description: Choose any recipient from the dropdown to preview their DM, or click 'View Random Sample' to spot-check different members.
recipient_selector.tip: Spot-checking 3 to 5 random members ensures section formatting and dividers look clean.

slack_dm_preview.title: Authentic Slack DM Simulated Preview
slack_dm_preview.description: A pixel-accurate simulation of the Slack desktop/mobile Direct Message interface, rendering bold text, section dividers, and header banners.
slack_dm_preview.tip: Toggle between dark and light themes using the theme dropdown.

raw_markdown.title: Raw Slack Markdown Payload
raw_markdown.description: Shows the exact plain-text payload string sent to the Slack API 'chat.postMessage' endpoint.
raw_markdown.tip: Useful for debugging raw formatting characters like asterisks and line breaks.

section_breakdown.title: Section-by-Section Breakdown
section_breakdown.description: An expander detailing how each song, group, or individual section was parsed for the currently selected recipient.
section_breakdown.tip: Helps diagnose if a particular section's comments were filtered out or assigned unexpectedly.

audit_all.title: Audit All Recipients at Once
audit_all.description: A searchable audit list displaying the generated feedback for all recipients simultaneously with a real-time name filter.
audit_all.tip: Type in the search box to quickly inspect a specific member's notes.

send_overview.title: Step 4: Review & Dispatch Messages
send_overview.description: The final stage where you can send a test DM to yourself first, choose which recipients to include, and broadcast messages.
send_overview.tip: Always send a test message first to verify that your Slack bot token works.

recipient_checklist.title: Recipient Selection Checklist
recipient_checklist.description: An interactive table with checkboxes allowing you to include or exclude specific members from the dispatch run.
recipient_checklist.tip: Uncheck members who should not receive messages, or members with missing Slack IDs.

test_send.title: Send Single Test Message First
test_send.description: Delivers a sample message directly and exclusively to your own Slack User ID or a test channel, without notifying actual members.
test_send.tip: Enter your own Slack User ID (e.g. 'U0XXXXXXXXX') and verify that the message appears in your Slack app.

broadcast_confirmation.title: Safety Broadcast Confirmation
broadcast_confirmation.description: A safety checkbox required before unlocking the bulk send button, preventing accidental live broadcasts.
broadcast_confirmation.tip: Check this box only after you have previewed comments and sent a successful test message.

broadcast_button.title: Live Dispatch & Delivery Logs
broadcast_button.description: Sends messages to all checked recipients via Slack's chat.postMessage API with rate limiting and exponential backoff.
broadcast_button.tip: Watch the progress bar and live delivery log to confirm successful delivery for each member.
